FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF CHEMISTRY
&
CENTRE OF ADVANCED STUDIES IN CHEMISTRY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
Applications are invited for the post of Project Associate-I of the following SERB Project
Title of Project: Synthesis, Reactivity and Structural Aspect of UO22+ ion with
Organoselenium Compounds Containing Heteroatom Donor Groups:
New Approach of Uranyl Functionalities in the Biological System
Positions: Project Associate-I (01)
Qualification: The candidates who have passed MSc in Chemistry with minimum 55% marks
are eligible to apply. The candidates should have qualified NET/GATE will be
given preference.
Stipend: As per SERB-SURE norms
Applications giving complete CV with all photo copies of the mark sheets and
certificates should reach on or before 10-12-2023 to Dr. Vijay Pal Singh as an
e-mail attachment to vijay@pu.ac.in
Please note that TA/DA will not be given to the candidates called for the interview.
Principle Investigator
Dr. Vijay Pal Singh
UGC-Assistant Professor
Department of Chemistry
Panjab University, Chandigarh
E-mail: vijay@pu.ac.in
